clips.name: dance
clips.prompt: person performs four reps of a complex dance choreography in one place

metrics.failure_screen: first pelvis z < 0.35 m or root tilt > 60 degrees; no early termination

review.note: Upright small steps and arm motions; close tracking, but not the requested complex choreography.

clips.name: turn
clips.prompt: individual in a neutral position makes a 90 degree turn to their left, stops, then repeats whole action many times

metrics.failure_screen: first pelvis z < 0.35 m or root tilt > 60 degrees; no early termination

review.note: Visible repeated turning with close reference/execution agreement; no fall in sampled frames.

clips.name: jump
clips.prompt: a jump reaching upwards as high as possible

metrics.failure_screen: first pelvis z < 0.35 m or root tilt > 60 degrees; no early termination

review.note: Upward arm reach is visible; reference pelvis peaks at 1.11 m while execution peaks at 0.84 m. The large requested jump is not reproduced.

clips.name: walk
clips.prompt: walk forward, lean down to pick up an object, then continue the walk

metrics.failure_screen: first pelvis z < 0.35 m or root tilt > 60 degrees; no early termination

review.note: Forward walking is visible and tracked; the requested bend/pickup phase is not apparent.

clips.name: run
clips.prompt: character waves back over left shoulder and talks with a child then starts to run backwards

metrics.failure_screen: first pelvis z < 0.35 m or root tilt > 60 degrees; no early termination

review.note: Backward-motion prompt produces locomotion, but large world-position drift develops; execution moves partly out of the matched camera. Root-position RMSE is 1.31 m.

clips.name: kick
clips.prompt: individual with an injured torso kicks an item on the ground and then takes three steps

metrics.failure_screen: first pelvis z < 0.35 m or root tilt > 60 degrees; no early termination

review.note: Low leg extensions/kicks and stepping are visible; no strong injured-torso style or exact three-step sequence is established.

clips.name: energetic_dance
clips.prompt: person performs four reps of a complex dance choreography in one place

metrics.failure_screen: first pelvis z < 0.35 m or root tilt > 60 degrees; no early termination

review.note: Small stepping and arm gestures, with a late arm spread. The complex four-repetition choreography is not established; the historical energetic name is retained.

clips.name: crouch_rebound
clips.prompt: high jump over a moving pole in one place

metrics.failure_screen: first pelvis z < 0.35 m or root tilt > 60 degrees; no early termination

review.note: A crouch and rebound are visible. The high-jump reference reaches 1.06 m pelvis height; execution reaches only 0.83 m and shows substantial height/orientation mismatch.

metrics.failure_screen: first pelvis z < 0.35 m or root tilt > 60 degrees; no early termination

review.note: Sustained forward walking is visible; execution remains upright but world-position drift accumulates (0.35 m root RMSE).

clips.name: side_step
clips.prompt: A person takes steps sideways to the left.

metrics.failure_screen: first pelvis z < 0.35 m or root tilt > 60 degrees; no early termination

review.note: Side-stepping motion is visible, but execution develops large positional drift (1.26 m root RMSE) and partly leaves the matched camera.

clips.name: wave_arms
clips.prompt: A person waves both arms overhead.

metrics.failure_screen: first pelvis z < 0.35 m or root tilt > 60 degrees; no early termination

review.note: Both arms rise, followed by asymmetric waving. Reference and execution agree closely; continuous symmetric overhead waving is not maintained.

clips.name: squat
clips.prompt: A person performs a squat and stands back up.

metrics.failure_screen: first pelvis z < 0.35 m or root tilt > 60 degrees; no early termination

review.note: Deep squat crosses the 0.35 m height screen at 7.90 s (minimum 0.31 m). No visible topple: pelvis tilt stays below 47 degrees. The robot does not fully stand back up by 20 s.

metrics.failure_screen: first pelvis z < 0.35 m or root tilt > 60 degrees; no early termination

review.note: Jump attempts are visible, but execution reaches only 0.84 m pelvis height versus 1.07 m in the reference; jump amplitude is not reproduced.

clips.name: front_kick
clips.prompt: A person kicks one leg forward.

metrics.failure_screen: first pelvis z < 0.35 m or root tilt > 60 degrees; no early termination

review.note: Low forward leg lifts/extensions appear late, with stepping and positional drift (0.38 m root RMSE); no strong front kick is established.

clips.name: punch
clips.prompt: A person throws a punch forward.

metrics.failure_screen: first pelvis z < 0.35 m or root tilt > 60 degrees; no early termination

review.note: Raised-arm gestures are tracked closely, but a clear forward punch is not apparent.

clips.name: spin
clips.prompt: A person spins around in place.

metrics.failure_screen: first pelvis z < 0.35 m or root tilt > 60 degrees; no early termination

review.note: Repeated rotation is visible and remains upright; unwrapped pelvis yaw changes by about 936 degrees in the reference and 899 degrees in execution.

presentation.note: Only GIF excerpt start times changed after recording; MP4, NPZ and JSON are byte-identical to the guarded runs. Preview offsets are in cases.json.

gpu_policy: One idle GPU at a time on hq-g1; 0.5 s process polling including compute and graphics. Foreign-process interruptions were discarded and retried with the same seed, never selected by motion outcome. See guards/queue.log.

validation.backend_checks: 40 fixed windows: exact repeated output, graph/eager TRT agreement, Torch adapter/upstream allclose; FP16 versus FP32 differences measured without an acceptance threshold
validation.initial_environment_failures: Missing pandas/pyarrow, then datasets; installed data dependencies in an isolated test-deps directory and reran the entire suite successfully. Shared training environment unchanged.
